inclusion_rule: Completed formal trials ending in success, time_limit, or manual interruption. Success and time_limit require an explicit evaluation start. Per operator policy, manual interruptions count as failures even if the start marker was missed; no evaluation time is inferred. Technical errors and incomplete simulations remain excluded. Missing start markers and webcam completeness, hand/clock matching and coverage are reported separately as evidence warnings

manual_corrections.reason: F5 (evaluation start) pressed after the grasp+lift had already occurred; PickBucket.reset() re-captured the table-height reference from the airborne bucket instead of its resting position (bug, fixed in dexjoco-shadow commit 7d961b2, shadow_ext/tasks.py), corrupting the recorded lifted/inside_reference_aabb fields for the rest of the trial.
manual_corrections.method: Replayed the trial's full raw MuJoCo state trace (saved every physics step, independent of the corrupted final_task_metrics) against the true baseline captured at the first recorded frame (sim_time ~0, before any operator input). shadow_ext/verify_task_reference.py, run against all 10 sessions: only 008's recorded reference was corrupted.

attempt_timing.method: shadow_ext/attempt_timing.py: first_motion = first saved physics frame where the hand's grasp site (rh-grasp_site) displaces >= 1cm from its frame-0 resting pose (stable threshold; 0.5cm fires on startup settling within 0.1s). first_success = first frame satisfying the task's success criterion against the true (frame-0) physical reference. This boundary is read from the same raw per-step trace for all ten trials and does not depend on the operator's F5 timing, unlike the evaluation-window timing in `trials[].evaluation`.

combined_series_summary.note: The automated `groups` above split by exact working-tree/provenance hash, which drifted between trials due to unrelated local file changes (including the reference-capture fix landing partway through the series); this summary rolls up all 10 shadow-only-formal-v1 trials as one series, per the agreed protocol (ThesisGCN/protocolo-validacion-funcional-registro-2026-09-07.md), and applies the manual_corrections entry for 008. Timing uses `attempt_timing` (motion-onset anchored), not the F5-anchored `evaluation.time_to_success_wall_s`, so no successful trial is excluded.
